scenarios.name: enters-may-attach-equipment-to-a-creature
scenarios.why: The optional enters trigger may attach a target Equipment you control to a target creature you control; the chosen Equipment ends up attached, so the Bears are 4/2.

scenarios.name: attaches-to-a-creature-you-control-not-an-opponents
scenarios.why: Both targets are restricted to permanents you control, so the opponent's Savannah Lions is never a legal creature target. With Bonesplitter and an own Grizzly Bears on the battlefield the trigger attaches the Equipment to the controller's own creature: the Bears become 4/2 and the opponent's Lions stay 2/1. This also fails if the attach does nothing at all (the Bears would stay 2/2), so it is not satisfied by an unperformed mechanic.
